description: Plan an immutable deployment. Preserve the customer's existing authentication integration, such as Better Auth or WorkOS. The explicitly selected managed Better Auth bridge requires the managed database; managed mail is optional. Omh Native Auth requires project rollout approval. A missing approval returns native_auth_launch_unavailable before a build is reserved. Never assume platform login proves application login. With no environment, the server chooses Dev if it exists, otherwise Prod. An explicit prod plan builds straight into Prod; shared data can affect Prod during migrations. Review the returned plan before deployment. The plan stays valid for 24 hours.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: deployment_plan
